# Saudagar Properties — AI & Agentic Browsing Manifest
> The Premier Real Estate Advisory & Luxury Property Consultant in DLF Gurugram (Phase 1–5, Sushant Lok, Golf Course Road & Cybercity).

Saudagar Properties is an authorized, veteran real estate consultancy operating in Gurugram (Gurgaon), Haryana, India, with over 25 years of proven transactional advisory and more than 1,000 High-Net-Worth Individual (HNI) clients.

## Core Capabilities & Market Coverage
- **DLF Phase 1–5 Builder Floors & Plots:** Ultra-luxury independent floors (200 to 1,000 sq. yards) with 100% clear titles, stilt parking, private terrace, and Italian marble finishes.
- **Sushant Lok & Golf Course Road Estates:** High-rise condominiums, duplex penthouses, and private gated villas with premium appreciation track records.
- **Cyber City & Udyog Vihar Grade-A Commercial:** Pre-leased corporate offices, retail spaces, and institutional assets delivering 7.5%–9.0% gross rental yields.
- **Title Due Diligence & Legal Vetting:** Complete DTCP, DLF, and Haryana Shahari Vikas Pradhikaran (HSVP) documentation, deed verification, and non-encumbrance validation.
